g.text: Single entry point. Analyzers are called as
detect(root, documents) or detect(root, documents, config).
Reads every discovered document once up front (_partition_readable);
unreadable or non-UTF-8 ones get a DS100 error finding from the engine
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 blocking findings, 2 config/scan failure.
Layers, lowest first: Config defaults < user settings JSON <
project TOML or --config file (.json allowed) < CLI flags.
Whole values are replaced, never merged. --no-user-settings turns
layer 2 off. A Config passed to scan() is used verbatim.
Library stays quiet (NullHandler). Only the CLI configures handlers.
Nearly every module (config, baseline, discovery, reporting, ...)
also calls safe() for untrusted text; edges shown are representative.
The first outbound network edge. Imported only after both
DOCSENTINEL_USE_EXTERNAL_API=1 AND the API key variable AND the
backend loads). extract-facts never reaches it.
importing docsentinel.detectors registers all fast rules
and the DS301 rule (spaCy not imported).
only readable ones go to analyzers
